description: The delegate error says to tick the box under 'Optional' on the approval page, but /connect hides it in a collapsed 'Details' row and no 'Optional' heading exists. Docs and llms.txt use a shorter wording of the label.
expected: Same label and location in CLI, docs and page.
actual: CLI: under Optional; page: inside Details; docs: shorter label
suggested_fix: Change the CLI text to 'open Details and tick ...' and unify the label.

description: The delegate error tells the agent to run `agent-drive login` again but not to pass the same --name (needed to reconnect the same agent instead of creating a new one).
suggested_fix: Print the agent's own name in the suggested command.

description: Repeated device logins end in 'Agent Drive refused the login request: slow_down' with no wait time, no explanation and no suggestion; it persisted over 20 minutes across fresh homes and names, and retrying appears to extend it. A user retrying a failed setup is locked out with an OAuth code.
expected: Too many login requests. Wait N minutes and try again.
suggested_fix: Map slow_down to a message with the wait time.
